As Devcon 8 comes to a close, join us for the Closing Ceremony to reflect on an unforgettable few days in Mumbai. We'll look back on the talks, workshops, and connections made across the week, celebrate the community that brought it all to life, and share a few words on where we go from here. It's a moment to say thank you, to look ahead, and to carry the energy of Devcon back out into the ecosystem. Until next time!
